We are a physician-owned teleradiology company that is committed to seamless operations, innovative technology, and exceptional services.  Be part of a team that's transforming healthcare through meaningful impact. Here, collaboration, passion, and adaptability drive everything we do! Summary The Business Systems Analyst owns Real Radiology's core business platforms — Salesforce, QGenda, and Campfire — including configuration, administration, documentation, and user adoption. This role owns the enhancement backlog for assigned platforms, leads vendor coordination on releases and new functionality, and delivers the documentation and training that drive adoption across the organization. The role reports to the Business Analysis Manager and partners closely with the Business Analyst and Senior Data Analyst, supporting Business Analyst project work as team priorities require. Serve as the primary business contact for platform vendors on releases, fixes, and new feature rollouts, coordinating with Information Technology where changes affect systems in HITRUST scope. Develop deep working knowledge of each platform's architecture, data flows, and integration points across the organization. Evaluate new platform features, modules, and vendor releases, and recommend adoption based on business need. System Administration Serve as system administrator for assigned platforms: manage configuration, workflows, and business rules. Submit and track user access requests — account creation, role assignment, and permission changes — for approval and provisioning by Information Technology, and verify that assigned access aligns with job function. Monitor system performance and data integrity; troubleshoot issues and escalate through Information Technology to the platform vendor as needed. Test configuration changes before production deployment, communicate changes to affected users in advance, and maintain a record of what changed and when. Documentation & Training Author and maintain user manuals, quick-reference guides, and standard operating procedures for each platform. Design and deliver training for new users and for existing users on new features or workflow changes. Keep documentation current as platforms, configurations, and processes evolve. Cross-Team Collaboration Partner with the Business Analyst on requirements gathering, process documentation, and implementation support for shared initiatives. Coordinate with the Senior Data Analyst on data structures, reporting needs, and platform data feeding financial and operational dashboards. Support the Business Analysis Manager with ad hoc analysis, reporting requests, and other Business Analyst-style deliverables as team priorities require.
